name: continuous-demo
description: Continuous five-layer DAG: prepare, ten workers, five reducers, two validators, summarize.

command:
set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [prepare] Input commit received; preparing 10 simulated partitions"
part=1
while [ "$part" -le 10 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [prepare] Prepared partition $part/10"
  sleep 1
  part=$((part + 1))
done
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [prepare] Preparation complete; releasing all 10 workers"

set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-01] Starting simulated partition 01; execution=${NEMO_JOB_STEP:-unknown}"
batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 6 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-01] Processing simulated batch $batch/6"
  sleep 4
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-01] Progress: $((batch * 100 / 6))%; simulated records=$((batch * 100))"
  batch=$((batch + 1))
done
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-01] SUCCESS; 600 simulated records processed"

set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-02] Starting simulated partition 02; execution=${NEMO_JOB_STEP:-unknown}"

while [ "$batch" -le 6 ]; do

set -eu

batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 6 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-03] Processing simulated batch $batch/6"
  sleep 3
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-03] Progress: $((batch * 100 / 6))%; simulated records=$((batch * 100))"
  batch=$((batch + 1))
done
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-03] SUCCESS; 600 simulated records processed"

set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-04] Starting simulated partition 04; execution=${NEMO_JOB_STEP:-unknown}"
batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 6 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-04] Processing simulated batch $batch/6"

set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-05] Starting simulated partition 05; execution=${NEMO_JOB_STEP:-unknown}"
batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 6 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-05] Processing simulated batch $batch/6"
  sleep 5
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-05] Progress: $((batch * 100 / 6))%; simulated records=$((batch * 100))"
  batch=$((batch + 1))
done
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-05] SUCCESS; 600 simulated records processed"

set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-06] Starting simulated partition 06; execution=${NEMO_JOB_STEP:-unknown}"
batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 6 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-06] Processing simulated batch $batch/6"

  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-06] Progress: $((batch * 100 / 6))%; simulated records=$((batch * 100))"

set -eu

batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 6 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-07] Processing simulated batch $batch/6"
  sleep 4
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-07] Progress: $((batch * 100 / 6))%; simulated records=$((batch * 100))"
  batch=$((batch + 1))
done
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-07] SUCCESS; 600 simulated records processed"

set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-08] Starting simulated partition 08; execution=${NEMO_JOB_STEP:-unknown}"
batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 6 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-08] Processing simulated batch $batch/6"
  sleep 5

batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 6 ]; do

set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [reduce-01] Starting after: worker-01, worker-02"
batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 4 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [reduce-01] Combining partitions: batch $batch/4 (simulated)"
  sleep 3
  batch=$((batch + 1))
done
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [reduce-01] SUCCESS; Combining partitions complete"

set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [reduce-02] Starting after: worker-03, worker-04"
batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 4 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [reduce-02] Combining partitions: batch $batch/4 (simulated)"
  sleep 3
  batch=$((batch + 1))

set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [reduce-03] Starting after: worker-05, worker-06"

set -eu

batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 4 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [validate-01] Checking first result group: batch $batch/4 (simulated)"
  sleep 3
  batch=$((batch + 1))
done
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [validate-01] SUCCESS; Checking first result group complete"

set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [validate-02] Starting after: reduce-04, reduce-05"
batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 4 ]; do

done
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [validate-02] SUCCESS; Checking second result group complete"

set -eu
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [summarize] Both validation groups finished; combining simulated results"
part=1
while [ "$part" -le 10 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [summarize] Collected worker $part/10"
  sleep 1
  part=$((part + 1))
done
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [summarize] PASS COMPLETE; waiting for the next Fileset commit"
